prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1239; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from behind while the patient was turning left. The patient reported acute low back pain radiating to the right paraspinal region, with stiffness and reduced range of motion, particularly with lumbar flexion and rotation. Neurological examination revealed intact motor strength and sensation in both lower extremities, with no focal deficits. Straight leg raise was negative bilaterally. The working diagnosis was acute lumbar strain without evidence of disc herniation or radiculopathy.

Treatment consisted of twelve outpatient physical therapy and chiropractic visits over the course of care, including manual therapy, graded lumbar stabilization exercises, and home exercise instruction. Modalities such as heat and electrical stimulation were used early in the course for pain control. The patient's symptoms improved steadily, with pain decreasing and functional mobility returning. At the most recent visit, the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms with only occasional stiffness after prolonged sitting. Residual limitation was minimal, and the patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
